pitches.name: Cabin Row Friction
pitches.beta: Glacier-polished friction with a bolt every few metres. Few holds: the rubber on your shoes is the climbing.

pitches.name: The Bulge
pitches.beta: Steeper slab to a rounded bulge. Chalk up on the stance below it.

cruxes.name: The bulge
cruxes.read: Hips out from the rock over the bulge, not in: weight on the smears is what holds you. Left hand twice, palm then edge.
